settings.eyebrow: Every animal deserves a second chance
settings.headline:
A safe harbor for
every stray.
settings.copy: Paws & Harbor rescues, rehabilitates, and rehomes abandoned animals across the county. We've given thousands of dogs and cats a fresh start — and we're just getting started.

settings.title: More than a shelter —
settings.intro: From the moment an animal arrives to the day they find their forever home, we're there at every step.

features.title: Rescue & intake
features.text: We pull animals from high-kill shelters, the streets, and neglectful situations — no matter their age or condition.

features.title: Veterinary care
features.text: Every animal receives exams, vaccinations, spay/neuter surgery, and treatment for any condition they arrived with.

features.title: Rehabilitation
features.text: Scared or injured animals get time, training, and patience until they're ready to trust people again.

features.title: Fostering
features.text: Our foster network gives animals a home while they wait to be adopted — socializing them and freeing shelter space.

features.title: Adoption matching
features.text: We match animals to the right families, with meet-and-greets and post-adoption support to make it stick.

features.title: Community education
features.text: Free spay/neuter clinics and pet-care workshops that keep more animals out of shelters in the first place.

settings.title: From application to

steps.title: Browse our animals
steps.text: Visit us or see our adoptable pets online to find one that sparks a connection.

steps.title: Apply to adopt
steps.text: Submit a short application so we can understand your home and lifestyle.

steps.title: Meet & greet
steps.text: We'll arrange a meet-and-greet so you and the animal can get to know each other.

steps.title: Home check
steps.text: A quick home visit confirms a safe, happy environment for your new family member.

steps.title: Welcome home!
steps.text: Sign the adoption papers, take them home, and start your life together. We're here if you need us.

settings.note: Adoption fees cover spay/neuter, vaccinations, and microchipping — every animal leaves fully prepared.

settings.title: Questions, answered
settings.intro: Everything you need to know about adopting, donating, and volunteering with us.

items.question: What does the adoption fee cover?
items.answer: Your adoption fee covers spay/neuter surgery, up-to-date vaccinations, microchipping, and a starter pack of food and supplies. It helps us rescue the next animal in need.

items.question: Can I foster an animal?
items.answer: Absolutely! Fostering is one of the most impactful things you can do. We provide all supplies, medical care, and support — you provide a loving home and a bit of your time.

items.question: Do you accept surrenders?
items.answer: Yes. If you can no longer care for your pet, we work with you to rehome them responsibly rather than leaving them at risk. Contact us to discuss the process.

items.question: How do my donations get used?
items.answer: Over 90% of donations go directly to animal care — food, veterinary bills, and shelter operations. The rest keeps our lights on and our team running.

settings.title: Visit us or reach out
settings.intro: Stop by to meet the animals, ask about fostering, or drop off supplies. We'd love to see you.

settings.blurb: A no-kill shelter giving abandoned animals a safe harbor and a second chance at a loving home.
